title: TOXIFRENCH: Benchmarking and Enhancing Language Models via CoT Fine-Tuning for French Toxicity Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on toxicity detection (e.g., hate speech, insults, and threats) in French online comments. While the taxonomy used for annotation includes a 'religion, beliefs, and spirituality' sub-category within the 'Register' dimension, the core objective of the work is safety-critical content moderation benchmarking rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as primary research subjects.
